description: This is a CLI script for managing Superset extensions, including validation, building, bundling, development mode, and initialization of extension projects. It handles frontend and backend setup, manifest creation, and file operations.

classes.name: FrontendChangeHandler
classes.description: Handles file system events to trigger frontend rebuilds when changes are detected.

methods.name: validate_npm
methods.description: Checks if npm is installed and its version meets the minimum requirement.

methods.name: init_frontend_deps
methods.description: Installs frontend dependencies using npm, either via 'npm ci' or 'npm i'.

methods.name: build_manifest
methods.description: Creates a manifest object for the extension based on extension.json and remote entry.

methods.name: write_manifest
methods.description: Writes the manifest JSON to the dist directory.

methods.name: run_frontend_build
methods.description: Runs 'npm run build' in the frontend directory to build assets.

methods.name: copy_frontend_dist
methods.description: Copies frontend build files to the dist directory and identifies the remote entry file.

methods.name: copy_backend_files
methods.description: Copies backend files specified in extension.json to the dist directory.

methods.name: rebuild_frontend
methods.description: Cleans, builds, and copies frontend assets, returning the remote entry filename.

methods.name: rebuild_backend
methods.description: Copies backend files to the dist directory.
